title: Did Einstein Believe in God? Spinoza Truth EXPOSED
description:
Did Albert Einstein believe in God?
Einstein famously said he believed in “Spinoza’s God”, but that quote is widely misunderstood.
In this video, we explain what Einstein actually meant, who Baruch Spinoza was, and why Einstein rejected a personal, religious God.

We break down Einstein’s views on religion, science, belief, and cosmic order in simple language, explain Spinoza’s idea of God as nature itself, and show why belief plays no role in scientific discovery. From relativity and spacetime to philosophy and rational thinking, this video clarifies one of the most misquoted ideas in modern science.

If you’ve searched for Did Einstein believe in God, Einstein God explained, Spinoza’s God, Einstein religion, scientists believe in God, this video gives you the rational perspective.
